Grain adjudicated conservatively at influenced, with BOTH cautions recorded: (1) NOT founding — no registered source applies founding verbs to him for process philosophy, and SEP Process Philosophy assigns follower-era language ('the early followers of Whitehead such as Hartshorne and Paul Weiss'); (2) NOT a mere disciple — SEP Charles Hartshorne: 'Most of the major elements of Hartshorne's philosophy were already apparent by the time he became familiar with Whitehead's thought, contrary to a popular misconception', and IEP warns 'It is a mistake, however, to style him as Whitehead's disciple'. The taxonomy has no finer relation for independent co-development; influenced plus this note is the record-not-resolve form. His strongest principal-figure language is scoped to process THEISM/theology ('its chief exponents', SEP Process Theism) — a future grain with no corpus node, recorded not proposed.
